name: Tompaládony (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, blue, white and blue, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Tompaládony: a crowned blue and green shield with a house, a bird and a well, above a scroll inscribed TOMPALÁDONY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tompaládony arms with crown and scroll
